title: Thinking on decision making when you lack certainty
summary: Starting from whether a potato could be Joyus's mascot, Kahran and Divya pull on the bigger thread of how to make decisions when you can't be certain. They land on shrinking the time horizon of a decision, asking what your future self needs to make a better next call, and treating the inputs to a decision as a network of confounders rather than a single weighted score.

intents.display: to get better at making decisions when you don't have certainty
